title: VigilOSS - Harness to help hunt for bugs in a structured smart way
description: VigilOSS is an AI-powered harness designed to assist in structured, long-running offensive security engagements such as code audits, web penetration tests, and bug bounty hunting. It coordinates specialist agents and tools to maintain investigation continuity, improve quality, and reduce false negatives. The tool emphasizes human oversight and verification, ensuring findings are reliable and reproducible. VigilOSS is intended for authorized use only and is provided under an Apache 2.0 license without warranty.

aiSummary: VigilOSS is an AI-driven framework that facilitates extended security assessments by managing multiple specialist agents and offensive security tools within a coordinated environment. It addresses common investigation failures like false negatives, assumption errors, and unreproducible reports by anchoring hypotheses, tracking investigative coverage, and requiring evidence-backed findings. The system supports white-box and black-box engagements, maintains detailed logs of tool executions and findings, and enforces a human-in-the-loop approach for quality control. It is designed to improve the thoroughness and reliability of security testing over long durations, with a focus on authorized and scoped use.
aiImpact: VigilOSS itself is not a vulnerability or exploit but a security tool that can enhance the effectiveness and quality of offensive security testing. It does not introduce direct security risks but requires responsible, authorized use to avoid unauthorized or harmful activities. There is no indication of vulnerabilities or exploits associated with VigilOSS from the provided data.
